cohort: 275 pregnant women with gestational or type 2 diabetes
finding: In pregnancies complicated by hyperglycemia, both small (<30th percentile) and large (>95th percentile) abdominal circumference and estimated fetal weight were associated with increased risk of adverse neonatal outcomes
mod_finding: In pregnancies complicated by hyperglycemia, mode of delivery was adjusted for when assessing the association between third trimester abdominal circumference and estimated fetal weight with adverse neonatal outcomes.
